Fitted classic ML model inference.

Applies a fitted Naive Bayes, KNN, Logistic Regression, SVM Classifier or SVM Regressor model to a table and appends a prediction column. The model comes from the Model input, or from a saved model file when the Model input is not connected. Feature columns are matched by the names the model was fitted on.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table with the model's feature columns |
| **Model** | Parameters | No | 1 | Fitted model from a classic ML node; when connected it is used instead of the saved model file |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Predictions** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus prediction column |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Artifact | Saved model | `model_path` | File | (empty) | `*.cyxclassic.json;*.json` | The run | Saved classic model (.cyxclassic.json) to use when the Model input is not connected. |
| Output | Prediction column | `prediction_col` | Text | `prediction` |   | The run | Name of the appended prediction column. |
| Output | Probability columns | `probability_columns` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Also append one probability column per class, named &lt;prediction column>_p_&lt;class> (for ROC and precision-recall) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
